name: BernNet (Bernstein filter)
tagline: Learnable Bernstein-polynomial spectral filter on the normalized Laplacian; non-negative coefficients via ReLU.
diff_from_baseline: He et al. 2021 (NeurIPS). Approximates arbitrary spectral filters via Bernstein polynomial basis on $[0,2]$ Laplacian spectrum; non-negativity enforces filter controllability. MLP encoder + Bernstein propagation.

name: ChebNetII (Cheb interp.)
tagline: Chebyshev-interpolation graph filter: learn filter values at Chebyshev nodes, convert to polynomial coefficients.
formula: $$h(\tilde L) = \sum_{k=0}^{K} c_k T_k(\tilde L),\qquad c_k = \frac{2}{K+1}\sum_{j=0}^{K} \mathrm{ReLU}(\theta_j)\, T_k\!\left(\cos\frac{(K-j+\tfrac{1}{2})\pi}{K+1}\right),\quad \tilde L = L - I$$
diff_from_baseline: He, Wei, Hong & Wang 2022 (NeurIPS). Avoids ChebNet's Runge phenomenon by interpolating the spectral filter at Chebyshev nodes instead of approximating monomial coefficients directly.

name: GPR-GNN
tagline: Generalized PageRank: learn per-hop polynomial coefficients in monomial basis, initialized uniformly.
formula: $$h(\hat A) = \sum_{k=0}^{K} \gamma_k\, \hat A^{k},\qquad \hat A = \tilde D^{-1/2}\tilde A\tilde D^{-1/2},\quad \gamma_k^{(0)} = \frac{1}{K+1}$$
diff_from_baseline: Chien, Peng, Li & Milenkovic 2021 (ICLR). Learnable monomial-basis polynomial filter — adaptive to homophilic and heterophilic graphs. Initialization is dataset-agnostic uniform; canonical learnable polynomial-filter baseline.

name: APPNP
tagline: Approximate Personalized PageRank propagation: K-step power iteration with teleport probability alpha.
formula: $$Z^{(0)} = H,\quad Z^{(k+1)} = (1-\alpha)\hat A Z^{(k)} + \alpha H,\quad k=0,\ldots,K-1$$
diff_from_baseline: Klicpera, Bojchevski & Gunnemann 2019 (ICLR). Decouples prediction (MLP) from propagation (fixed personalized PageRank). Filter is fixed (not learned); only MLP trained. Standard heterophily-aware baseline.

name: SGC
tagline: Simplified Graph Convolution: linear layer + K-hop adjacency power, no nonlinearities between layers.
formula: $$Y = \mathrm{softmax}\!\left(\hat A^{K} X W\right),\qquad \hat A = \tilde D^{-1/2}\tilde A \tilde D^{-1/2},\quad K = 2$$
diff_from_baseline: Wu, Souza, Zhang, Fifty, Yu & Weinberger 2019 (ICML). Removes intermediate nonlinearities of GCN, collapsing to a single linear classifier on $\hat A^K X$. Equivalent to GPR-GNN with only the K-th coefficient = 1.
